library.description: Asynchronous runtime-neutral logging host with composable delivery features.

blocks.text: 异步日志 host。日志调用同步返回，条目随后按顺序经过异步管线与输出策略。控制台、HTTP、文件、进程收尾、reasoning 和持久日志由独立插件提供。

blocks.code:
import { createLogHost, levelPlugin } from '@migaia/log-host'
import { consolePlugin } from '@migaia/log-plugin-console'

/** host 拥有插件安装、日志交付与最终释放。 */
const log = createLogHost({ plugins: [levelPlugin(), consolePlugin()] })
log.info('request completed', { requestId: 'r1' })
await log.flush()
await log.shutdown('manual')

blocks.text: `info()` 返回时输出尚未开始。`flush()` 等待已接纳的条目、异步交付与插件缓冲区；默认等待预算为 3000 毫秒。`shutdown()` 先运行最后日志处理器，再停止准入、排空并释放插件。并发 shutdown 返回同一个 Promise。

blocks.code:
import { createLogHost, levelPlugin } from '@migaia/log-host'
import { thresholdFeature, uuidFeature } from '@migaia/log-host/features'
import { consolePlugin } from '@migaia/log-plugin-console'

/** host 级策略作为每个输出端的默认值；entry 策略只执行一次。 */
const log = createLogHost({
  features: [thresholdFeature({ level: 'info' }), uuidFeature({ display: false })],
  plugins: [levelPlugin(), consolePlugin()]
})
log.debug('filtered by this output')
log.info('accepted')
await log.shutdown('manual')

blocks.text: 内置 feature：`thresholdFeature`、`filterFeature`、`uuidFeature`、`formatFeature`、`batchFeature`、`retryFeature`、`timeoutFeature`。支持汇总入口 `./features` 和各自的默认导出，例如 `./features/retry`。
输出级同 kind 策略覆盖 host 默认值。每个作用域只允许一个 format，无论 kind 是否相同；输出级 format 覆盖 host format。交付顺序固定为门槛、过滤、自定义 gate、格式、批量、重试、超时、输出，与内置 feature 的数组顺序无关。
输出可声明 `consumesText: false`，只接收原条目与取消信号，跳过 host 格式阶段；该输出不能配置 format 或 defaultFormat。条目处理、gate 与交付策略照常执行。

items: 日志方法不抛出运行期交付错误；`flush()` 与 `shutdown()` 总是兑现。失败通过 `onFailure()` 观察；没有监听器时交给 `report`。
监听器失败以 `HOOK_FAILED` 交给 reporter，原错误保留在 `cause`。reporter 自身失败会被收住，不递归报告。
非法创建配置同步抛带 `source`、`code` 的错误。`use()`、`unUse()` 是配置操作，可以拒绝。
durable 的 append、commit、read 与失效句柄仍按存储契约拒绝；日志的非 throw 保证不覆盖事务操作。
待处理条目默认上限 10000，超出时丢弃最旧的未处理条目并报告 `QUEUE_OVERFLOW`。

rows: `createLogHost`、`levelPlugin`、`forwardPlugin`、状态、默认 reporter 与 host 类型

blocks.text: host 不内置输出端，不依赖第三方运行时包。底层能力来自 `@migaia/plugin-host`、`@migaia/middleware-pipeline`、`@migaia/lifecycle`、`@migaia/event-subscriber` 与 `@migaia/utils`。
完整用法见 USEGUIDE.md。

blocks.code:
import { createLogHost, levelPlugin } from '@migaia/log-host'
import { consolePlugin } from '@migaia/log-plugin-console'

/** 每个 host 独立拥有上下文、插件与交付队列。 */
const log = createLogHost({
  context: ['orders'],
  topic: 'api',
  maxPending: 10000,
  plugins: [levelPlugin(), consolePlugin()]
})
log.info('created', { orderId: 'o1' })
log.log('audit', 'arbitrary tags remain valid')
await log.flush()
await log.shutdown('manual')

blocks.text: 选项包括 `plugins`、`features`、`context`、`topic`、`maxPending`、`scheduler`、`randomUUID`、`report` 与 plugin-host 的 `execution`。调度器默认使用 utils `systemScheduler`；UUID 默认使用 `globalThis.crypto.randomUUID()`，也可按 host 注入。
注入的调度器必须在 `schedule()` 返回 receipt 后才运行 callback；返回之前同步调用 callback 不在支持范围内。
host 门面被冻结。`ctx` 的顶层容器、上下文路径与环境标记也被冻结；嵌套用户值与 Date 保留身份，不做深克隆。`dispatchRaw()` 同步复制输入条目的顶层数组与对象，忽略输入 id，生成自己的条目 id。输出端各自收到浅快照；原生 Error 与嵌套业务对象保持身份。
`levelPlugin()` 添加 `debug`、`info`、`warn`、`error`、`fatal` 与 `atLevel`。字符串首参作为 message，其余参数保留原生类型；非字符串首参进入 args。插件本身不做过滤。
门槛只解释标准级别；普通未知 tag 跳过级别比较，仍经过过滤。`atLevel()` 保留业务 tag，并携带其标准级别供门槛解释。UUID 总是写入 `data.uuid`，`display` 只控制 `data.uuidDisplay`，不关闭生成。
每个输出端按门槛、过滤、自定义 gate、格式、批量、重试、超时、实际输出的固定顺序交付。内置 feature 的数组顺序不会改变这条顺序。
host 级 output feature 是默认值，输出级相同 kind 的 feature 覆盖它。未覆盖的 host 自定义 gate 先运行，输出级 gate 随后按声明顺序运行。entry feature 只允许装在 host 级。
同一作用域重复 kind 会在创建时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。format 还按阶段唯一：即使 kind 不同，一个作用域也只允许一个 format。跨作用域允许各有一个，最终优先级是输出级显式 format、host 级显式 format、输出插件 `defaultFormat`。

rows: 按顺序运行 predicates，任一返回 false 即停止；支持 `add()`
用当前 host 的生成器丰富条目
为可批量输出端提供有界缓冲与排空
基于 utils retry；attempts 是含首次调用的总次数
基于 utils withTimeout 限制一次交付

blocks.text: batch 默认 `maxSize: 20`、`maxWaitMs: 2000`、`maxConcurrentBatches: 1`、`maxPendingBatches: 1024`、`drainTimeoutMs: 3000`。容量同时计入排队和执行中的批次；满时丢弃最旧的排队批次，若所有槽位都在执行中则丢弃传入批次，并报告带 `detail.dropped` 的 `BATCH_OVERFLOW`。移除输出插件时先排空最后缓冲，再撤销交付所用的注册 signal。
retry 的 `attempts` 必须显式给出正安全整数；`backoff` 可为毫秒数或接收失败尝试序号的函数。输出端的 `retryable` 决定是否继续；`retryDelay` 的值经 `beforeRetry` 接入，并优先于普通 backoff。超时通过失败通道报告 `DELIVERY_FAILED`，原始 utils 超时错误保留在 `cause`。
交付失败且 timeout 清理也失败时，`retryable` 与 `retryDelay` 收到原始交付错误。清理错误在原聚合中依次跟在主错误后，该聚合保留在 `logging / DELIVERY_FAILED` 包装的 `cause`。交付成功后的清理失败只报告一次，经相同 host 错误边界离开，不重发已成功的操作。
`deliver` 接收 `readonly ILogOutputRecord[]` 和只读 `{ signal, format }`。record 同时包含原生 `entry` 与已选格式的 `text`。context.format 与最终选中的 descriptor 是同一个对象。输出包可由自己的 pretty descriptor 身份选择原生参数渲染，不猜测文本或重做格式优先级。

不消费文本的输出声明 `consumesText: false` 并省略 `defaultFormat`。其回调收到只含 `entry` 的 record 与只含 `signal` 的 context；host 跳过该输出的格式阶段，输出级配置任何 format 都在创建时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。entry、gate、批量、重试与超时照常执行。省略 consumesText 则保留原文本回调类型与必填 defaultFormat。

`defineOutputPlugin` 的可选 `install(core)` 返回扩展对象，host 与动态 use 句柄会保留其精确类型。非输出插件使用 `ILogPlugin` 形状。插件 core 提供安装期资源登记、scoped config、lifecycle、scheduler、sink、failure、defer、flush 与 shutdown 能力；资源通过真实 plugin-host 生命周期回滚与释放。
第三方 feature 用 `defineLogFeature()` 签发，完整实现 entry、gate 或 format 中一种。delivery 阶段只由内置 batch/retry/timeout 工厂提供。描述对象被冻结；普通字面量、浅复制和类型断言都不能制造运行期签发身份。

`projectLogEntry(entry)` 是共享结构化投影。它只把 error 替换为 utils `serializeErrorChain(entry.error.raw)`；保留 source、code、name、message、stack、cause 与 aggregate 分支，排除 raw 的自有私有字段。JSON 格式与 HTTP envelope 共用该投影，原始 entry.error.raw 不变。
日志方法与 flush/shutdown 的运行期错误不会进入业务控制流；创建配置错误与 use/unUse 的配置拒绝仍可离开调用边界。没有失败监听器时直接调用 reporter；监听器失败产生 `HOOK_FAILED`，原异常在 cause。reporter 自身抛错、then getter 失败或拒绝均被收住，终端失败不再递归上报。
`flush()` 的 3000 毫秒默认预算不证明所有日志已经送达。到期报告 `LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE` 并兑现；未完成工作的晚到拒绝仍被观察。shutdown 共享同一个 Promise，保留第一个 reason，先运行允许写最后日志的处理器，再关闭准入并释放插件。释放结果中的 `cleanupErrors` 必须由业务按需要检查。
`forwardPlugin({ targets })` 把当前 host 处理后的逻辑条目转交给目标 host，目标自己的管线与策略仍然执行。安装时拒绝自身与多跳环，分别使用 `FORWARD_SELF`、`FORWARD_CYCLE`。源 host 的 flush 包含目标的异步工作。
`use(...plugins)` 返回按输入顺序排列的真实 plugin-host 句柄元组；原变量的静态类型不会因动态安装而增加方法。`unUse(name)` 返回 peer 的 removal 结果，重复移除不存在插件会拒绝。撤销 forward 插件移除其边；源 shutdown 不关闭目标 host。

An asynchronous logging host. Log calls return synchronously; entries then pass through an ordered asynchronous pipeline and output policies. Separate plugins provide console, HTTP, file, process shutdown, reasoning and durable logging.

blocks.code:
import { createLogHost, levelPlugin } from '@migaia/log-host'
import { consolePlugin } from '@migaia/log-plugin-console'

/** The host owns plugin installation, delivery and terminal cleanup. */
const log = createLogHost({ plugins: [levelPlugin(), consolePlugin()] })
log.info('request completed', { requestId: 'r1' })
await log.flush()
await log.shutdown('manual')

blocks.text: Output has not started when `info()` returns. `flush()` drains admitted entries, tracked asynchronous work and plugin buffers within a default 3000 ms wait budget. `shutdown()` runs final-log handlers, closes admission, drains and releases plugins. Concurrent shutdown calls share the same Promise.

blocks.code:
import { createLogHost, levelPlugin } from '@migaia/log-host'
import { thresholdFeature, uuidFeature } from '@migaia/log-host/features'
import { consolePlugin } from '@migaia/log-plugin-console'

/** Host policies are output defaults; entry enrichment executes once per entry. */
const log = createLogHost({
  features: [thresholdFeature({ level: 'info' }), uuidFeature({ display: false })],
  plugins: [levelPlugin(), consolePlugin()]
})
log.debug('filtered by this output')
log.info('accepted')
await log.shutdown('manual')

blocks.text: Built-ins are `thresholdFeature`, `filterFeature`, `uuidFeature`, `formatFeature`, `batchFeature`, `retryFeature` and `timeoutFeature`. Import them together from `./features` or use individual default exports such as `./features/retry`.

Output-local policies replace host defaults of the same kind. Each scope admits one format regardless of kind; an output format replaces the host format. The fixed delivery order is threshold, filter, custom gates, format, batch, retry, timeout and transport, independently of built-in descriptor array order.

An output can declare `consumesText: false` to receive entries and a cancellation signal while skipping host formatting. It cannot configure a format or defaultFormat. Entry processing, gates and delivery policies still apply.

items: Log methods contain runtime delivery errors. `flush()` and `shutdown()` always fulfill. Observe failures with `onFailure()`; otherwise the host calls `report`.
Listener failures reach the reporter as `HOOK_FAILED`, with the original on `cause`. Reporter failures are contained without recursive reporting.
Invalid creation options throw identified errors synchronously. Configuration operations `use()` and `unUse()` may reject.
Durable append, commit, read and invalid-handle operations keep their storage rejection contract. The logging guarantee does not mask transaction failures.
The default pending-entry capacity is 10000. Overflow drops the oldest unprocessed entry and reports `QUEUE_OVERFLOW`.

rows: Host factory, level/forward plugins, status, default reporter and host types
Feature/output definitions, shared error projection and plugin author types

blocks.text: The host includes no output transport or third-party runtime dependency. It uses `@migaia/plugin-host`, `@migaia/middleware-pipeline`, `@migaia/lifecycle`, `@migaia/event-subscriber` and `@migaia/utils`.
See USEGUIDE.en.md for complete usage.

blocks.code:
import { createLogHost, levelPlugin } from '@migaia/log-host'
import { consolePlugin } from '@migaia/log-plugin-console'

/** Each host independently owns context, plugin registrations and its delivery queue. */
const log = createLogHost({
  context: ['orders'],
  topic: 'api',
  maxPending: 10000,
  plugins: [levelPlugin(), consolePlugin()]
})
log.info('created', { orderId: 'o1' })
log.log('audit', 'arbitrary tags remain valid')
await log.flush()
await log.shutdown('manual')

blocks.text: Options are `plugins`, `features`, `context`, `topic`, `maxPending`, `scheduler`, `randomUUID`, `report` and plugin-host `execution`. The scheduler defaults to utils `systemScheduler`; UUID generation defaults to `globalThis.crypto.randomUUID()`. Both may be injected per host.
An injected scheduler must run callbacks after `schedule()` returns its receipt. Callbacks invoked synchronously before the receipt is returned are unsupported.

The host facade and top-level context containers are frozen. Nested user values and Date instances retain identity. `dispatchRaw()` captures shallow input containers synchronously and generates its own id. Each output receives a shallow snapshot; native errors and nested business objects retain their identities.
`levelPlugin()` adds `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`, `fatal` and `atLevel`. A string first argument becomes message; other values remain native args. The plugin performs no filtering itself.

Unknown tags bypass only the standard level threshold. `atLevel()` keeps the business tag while supplying an explicit standard level. UUID enrichment always writes `data.uuid`; display controls only `data.uuidDisplay`.

The fixed order is threshold, filter, custom gates, format, batch, retry, timeout and transport, independently of built-in descriptor array order. Output-local policies replace host defaults of the same kind. Surviving host gates precede local gates, retaining each scope's declaration order. Entry features are allowed only at host scope.

Duplicate kinds fail at creation with `INVALID_OPTION`. A scope also admits at most one format, regardless of kind. Across scopes, selection is output explicit format, host explicit format, then the output's `defaultFormat`.

rows: Entry enrichment using the installing host's generator
Canonical utils retry; attempts includes the first call
Canonical utils timeout for one attempt

blocks.text: Batch defaults are `maxSize: 20`, `maxWaitMs: 2000`, `maxConcurrentBatches: 1`, `maxPendingBatches: 1024` and `drainTimeoutMs: 3000`. Capacity counts queued and active batches. Overflow drops the oldest queued batch, or the incoming batch when every slot is active, and reports `BATCH_OVERFLOW` with `detail.dropped`. Output removal drains its final buffer before revoking the registration signal used for delivery.

Retry requires an explicit positive safe-integer attempts count. Backoff is milliseconds or a function receiving the failed attempt's index. Transport `retryable` controls repetition; `retryDelay` is captured through `beforeRetry` and takes precedence over ordinary backoff. Timeout failures report `DELIVERY_FAILED`, retaining the canonical utils timeout on cause.

When delivery fails and timeout cleanup also fails, `retryable` and `retryDelay` receive the original delivery error. Cleanup failures follow it in the original aggregate, retained on a `logging / DELIVERY_FAILED` wrapper's `cause`. Cleanup after successful delivery reports once through the same host error boundary and never replays the successful operation.

`deliver` receives readonly records and `{ signal, format }`. Each record carries native entry and selected text. `context.format` is the exact selected descriptor, allowing a pretty output owner to recognize its own format without guessing text or repeating priority resolution.

Set `consumesText: false` and omit `defaultFormat` for an entry-only output. Its callback receives records containing only `entry` and a context containing only `signal`. Host formatting is skipped for that output; configuring any output-local format throws `INVALID_OPTION` at creation. Entry features, gates, batching, retry and timeout still apply. Omitting `consumesText` keeps the existing text callback types and required defaultFormat.

Optional `install(core)` returns precisely inferred extensions on the initial host and dynamic plugin handles. Other plugins use `ILogPlugin`. The real core provides scoped config, lifecycle, scheduler, install-owned resources, sinks, failures, deferred work, flush and shutdown. Plugin-host retains rollback and resource ownership.

Use `defineLogFeature()` to issue complete entry, gate or format implementations. Delivery descriptors are internal to built-in batch/retry/timeout factories. Descriptors are frozen; object literals, shallow copies and type assertions cannot manufacture runtime issuance.

`projectLogEntry(entry)` replaces only error with utils `serializeErrorChain(entry.error.raw)`. Structured output retains source, code, name, message, stack, cause and aggregate branches while excluding raw private fields. JSON and HTTP use this same projection; the original native raw object remains unchanged.

Log methods and flush/shutdown contain runtime failures. Creation errors and configuration use/unUse rejection remain visible to callers. Without failure listeners the reporter receives the error directly. Listener failures report `HOOK_FAILED` with the original on cause. Reporter throws, hostile then getters and rejections remain contained without recursive reporting.

The default 3000 ms flush budget is a bounded wait, not proof of successful delivery. A deadline reports `LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE` and fulfills; late rejections remain observed. Shutdown shares one Promise and the first reason. Final-log handlers run before admission closes and plugins release. Inspect structured `cleanupErrors` when cleanup matters to the application.

`forwardPlugin({ targets })` forwards processed logical entries into target hosts' own pipelines and policies. Installation rejects self-links and multi-hop cycles as `FORWARD_SELF` and `FORWARD_CYCLE`. Source flush includes target asynchronous work.

`use(...plugins)` returns the canonical input-ordered handle tuple without changing the original variable's static extension type. `unUse(name)` returns the peer removal result; removing an absent registration rejects. Removing forward disconnects its edges. Source shutdown leaves target hosts alive.

`flush()` 的 3000 毫秒默认预算不证明所有日志已经送达。到期报告 `LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE` 并兑现；未完成工作的晚到拒绝仍被观察。shutdown 共享同一个 Promise，保留第一个 reason，先运行允许写最后日志的处理器，再关闭准入并释放插件。释放结果中的 `cleanupErrors` 必须由业务按需要检查。

entry: An admitted ILogEntry retaining its original native Error reference locally.
A wire-safe error projection of the entry; native error.raw is omitted and the bounded original error chain is serialized.

symbols.identity: packages/log-host/dist/projection.d.ts:projectLogEntry:export declare function projectLogEntry(entry: ILogEntry): ILogProjectedEntry;

blocks.text: `projectLogEntry(entry)` 是共享结构化投影。它只把 error 替换为 utils `serializeErrorChain(entry.error.raw)`；保留 source、code、name、message、stack、cause 与 aggregate 分支，排除 raw 的自有私有字段。JSON 格式与 HTTP envelope 共用该投影，原始 entry.error.raw 不变。
日志方法与 flush/shutdown 的运行期错误不会进入业务控制流；创建配置错误与 use/unUse 的配置拒绝仍可离开调用边界。没有失败监听器时直接调用 reporter；监听器失败产生 `HOOK_FAILED`，原异常在 cause。reporter 自身抛错、then getter 失败或拒绝均被收住，终端失败不再递归上报。
`flush()` 的 3000 毫秒默认预算不证明所有日志已经送达。到期报告 `LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE` 并兑现；未完成工作的晚到拒绝仍被观察。shutdown 共享同一个 Promise，保留第一个 reason，先运行允许写最后日志的处理器，再关闭准入并释放插件。释放结果中的 `cleanupErrors` 必须由业务按需要检查。
